verdict.rationale: SumUp documents a public API in several ways. These include the Cloud API driven over HTTPS requests, checkout creation through the official @sumup/sdk, refunds, and API-key authorization that lets an application act on behalf of the merchant account. A community developer independently built an integration through SumUp's public API. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404 on every candidate path).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Trigger and manage payments on Solo or Go readers via HTTPS requests.
API keys are static credentials that let your application act on behalf of the merchant account that created the key.
The `@sumup/sdk` package wraps SumUp API, ships TypeScript declarations, and works in modern JavaScript runtimes and platforms
Developer built low-cost receipt printer integration for SumUp by hacking the system through SumUp's public API
